Say this (Dagaare): A naŋkpaana da la moɔ yaga kyɛ ba nyɛ nɛne.
Meaning (English): The hunter wandered all day but did not get any game.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba maŋ ti la sampare daa poɔ.
Meaning (English): Sheds are often put up at the marketplace.

Say this (Dagaare): Wa daa ane Kaane daa la maŋ laŋ kpɛ.
Meaning (English): The Wa market day and Kaane market day fall on the same day.

Say this (Dagaare): O naŋ wa kyɛ, o daare ayi la.
Meaning (English): It is two weeks since he came here.

Say this (Dagaare): Sẽɛ̃ saŋa bondirii daa maŋ do la.
Meaning (English): The cost of food rises during the middle of the farming season.
Did s/he come here last time?

Say this (Dagaare): Daa-daa ka a dɔɔta maŋ wa.
Ka fooŋ kyiri kãã eŋ kõɔ poɔ a maŋ iri daale la.
Meaning (English): If oil is poured into water it will float on the top.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka a toma ŋaŋ wa baare N na nyɛ la daama fẽẽ.
Meaning (English): When this work is over I shall be free a bit.

Say this (Dagaare): O naŋ gaa o sori na te waana la ka o daane (la) o zaa.
Meaning (English): Returning from his trip he had changed completely.

Say this (Dagaare): O poɔ sãaɛ la ka o daane o niŋe bare ziyuo.
Meaning (English): She was sad and turned her face away.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka bibileŋ ba nyɛ wuluu velaa o bile saŋa, o maŋ daare la.
Meaning (English): If a child does not get good guidance during his early life, he gets out of hand.

Say this (Dagaare): Uoni saŋa kommie daaroŋ maŋ e la kpeɛŋaa.
Meaning (English): During the dry season the cost of tomatoes goes high.

Say this (Dagaare): A pɔge tõɔ lɔɔ la a dɔɔ, dabagelakala.
Meaning (English): The woman was able to throw the man down; that's great!

Say this (Dagaare): Selaa de zeɛ la a nɔlee kaŋa, ka N da baŋ ka lɛ N pɔge a.
Meaning (English): A hawk has snatched one of the chickens; if I had known, I would have put them in a pen.

Say this (Dagaare): A seŋ ka karemamine maŋ de karembiiri dabaŋkoroŋ wuli ba.
Meaning (English): Teachers should base their teaching on pupils' prior knowledge.
The burning flame is looking dangerous.

Say this (Dagaare): Nyɛ, a dɔɔŋ leɛ zoro, dabeɛmɛ la.
Meaning (English): Look, the man is running away, he is a coward.

Say this (Dagaare): Dabuori ka fo tu fo sori na?
Meaning (English): When will you make your trip?

Say this (Dagaare): Ziyuo vɛŋɛɛ la ka Dagaareŋ deɛ bɔrɔ.
Meaning (English): Civilisation is killing most of the traditional practices of the Dagaaba.

Say this (Dagaare): A bie taa la dagaŋgaŋ, fo na yeli ka sõɔ.
Meaning (English): The child is so full of wit that it might be attributed to witchraft.

Say this (Dagaare): N nɛɛse dakyɛ la so ka a bie kpi.
Meaning (English): The child died because of the nurse's carelessness.

Say this (Dagaare): A pɔgelee zagere la a toma kyɛ yele o dala.
Meaning (English): The girl refused to do the work and put on airs.

Say this (Dagaare): A nannyige daleerɛ zaa ka a polisri baŋ.
Meaning (English): The police have gotten to know all the thief's tricks.

Say this (Dagaare): O yɛlɛ na o naŋ yeli ba taa daliiri.
Meaning (English): There is no substance in his/her speech.

Say this (Dagaare): Bayuo la a zoobu danwẽɛ soba.
Meaning (English): Bayuo is the first in the race.
S/he has travelled by plane before.

Say this (Dagaare): N na daŋ fo la ta.
Meaning (English): I will get there before you.

Say this (Dagaare): Zenɛ, o daŋe la toma waabo.
Meaning (English): Today s/he came to work early.

Say this (Dagaare): Zenɛ, o daŋe la toma waabo gaŋe bebiri zaa.
Meaning (English): Today s/he came to work earlier than all other days.

Say this (Dagaare): N deɛ ba baŋ a pare.
O gaa la a tigiri te deɛ.
Meaning (English): S/he went to the feast and never returned.

Say this (Dagaare): A bibiiri ba nɔŋe a deɛne ŋa.
Meaning (English): The children do not like this play.

Say this (Dagaare): Bonso ka fo de a yelnimize ŋa eŋe deɛne?
Meaning (English): Why do you take this serious matter for a joke?

Say this (Dagaare): Zenɛ te na kaa la karembiiri deɛne na naŋ kyaare ‘bibiiri emmaaroŋ yɛlɛ’.
Meaning (English): Today we shall watch a drama piece by pupils on the title ‘children’s health’.

Say this (Dagaare): Fo deme la gaŋ n deme.
A dagere poɔ n deni la bile.
Meaning (English): Among the boxes mine (the one that belongs to me) is the smallest.

Say this (Dagaare): Pampana ŋa ka ba salle a dankyini o naŋ ba deri.
Meaning (English): The wall has just been plastered and is not hardened yet.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka kɔmmaaroŋ waare pɔgenyaŋaa naŋ zoro ɔɔre o na deri la.
Meaning (English): If cold water is accidently sprayed with water she will collapse in cold.

Say this (Dagaare): Da maaroŋ ka ba maŋ dɛnne, ba ba dɛnnɛ dakuoŋaa.
Meaning (English): You can straighten a fresh stick, but not a dry one.

Say this (Dagaare): A teŋɛ zaa ka o dɛnne kyɛ naŋ ba bale.
Meaning (English): She has roamed the whole town but is not tired yet.

Say this (Dagaare): Saa mie la ka a baa dɛnne o zaa.
Meaning (English): It has rained and the stream is full to capacity.

Say this (Dagaare): Vũũ di la a tuu zaa.
Meaning (English): The whole shrub has been burnt down by fire.

Say this (Dagaare): A bie noɔre die la ka ba sage na di bonzaa.
Meaning (English): The child has a sore mouth and refuses to eat anything.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba di la ba zɔɔre sɛrɛɛ na baare.
Meaning (English): They have finished judging that case of fighting.

Say this (Dagaare): A teɛ da le dii la a lɔɔre ka noba perre.
Meaning (English): The tree fell on the car and injured some people.

Say this (Dagaare): A boɔre la dii taa do teɛ a dasɛrɛɛ.
Meaning (English): The bags are packed on top of each other up to the ceiling.

Say this (Dagaare): A yidaampɔge dii la a bɛŋɛ ne tampɛloŋ ka a na ta sãã.
Meaning (English): The head of the women preserved the bean seed in ash to prevent it from getting destroyed by insects.

Say this (Dagaare): O dogi la a kuuri na naŋ pare a dankyini zu.
Meaning (English): S/he has removed the stone from the top of the wall.

Say this (Dagaare): A pɔge e la bɛroŋ donforoŋ lɛ.
Meaning (English): The woman is big and puffed.

Say this (Dagaare): A saa da doŋe te la ka te zo fãã kyɛ ka poɔ te.
Meaning (English): The rain was so close we could not escape and therefore were caught in the downpour.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba doore la kõɔ lɛɛ te bale ba zaa.
Meaning (English): They heaved water until they became tired.

Say this (Dagaare): O doɔ la o zu dayeni kyɛ leɛ gaŋ
Meaning (English): S/he raised his/her head once and laid back down.

Say this (Dagaare): A dɔɔ ŋmɛ la a bie doɔ bare.
Meaning (English): The man worsened the situation by beating the child.
The river is overflowing its banks.

Say this (Dagaare): A bie dɔge la a nɛne a saabo zu.
Meaning (English): The child has taken the meat which was on top of the food.

Say this (Dagaare): De a nɛne dɔgele dankyini zu ka baare ta wa de o.
Meaning (English): Place the meat on the wall so that dogs do not eat it.

Say this (Dagaare): A bie yɔɔ la a libie ka a dɔgele ka a seŋ ka fo leɛ de a dɔgelɔ ko o.
Meaning (English): The child has overpaid and so the extra money should be returned to him.

Say this (Dagaare): N woŋ la dɔɔne a die poɔ, neɛkaŋa be la be.
Meaning (English): I have heard some noise in the room, there must be someone in there.

Say this (Dagaare): Te nyɛ la a baala nɔgbɛmɛ dɔɔne kyɛ te ba woŋi a yɛlɛ o naŋ yeli.
Meaning (English): We saw some movement of the patient’s lips but we did not hear what s/he said.

Say this (Dagaare): A pɔge yeli ka o ba boɔrɔ dɔɔne ka anaŋ so ka o yi.
Meaning (English): The woman said she did not want trouble and that is why she divorced.

Say this (Dagaare): Te na e o la velaa.
A dɔɔ e la a kyi ko a pɔge.
Meaning (English): The man has fetched millet for the woman.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba eɛ la a yɛlɛ fẽẽ ka N woŋ.
Meaning (English): They have given me a hint of the situation.

Say this (Dagaare): A bie zu pɔre la maŋgo ka a daana waana ka o eɛ eŋ.
Meaning (English): The boy stole a mango and when he saw the owner coming he took to his heels.
As for me I won't go.

Say this (Dagaare): o ɔŋ la kõɔ eŋe a doge poɔ.
Meaning (English): S/he has put water into the pot.

Say this (Dagaare): A seŋe ka bibile maŋ eŋe neŋkpoŋ.
Meaning (English): The young should respect the elderly.

Say this (Dagaare): A teŋɛ deme zaa taa la eŋene kora a naa.
Meaning (English): All the people in town have respect for the chief.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka fooŋ ba kyɛlle a bie ŋa na fa la, bonso ka o ba maŋ kpɛ die wĩeu?
Meaning (English): If you are not careful, this child will go bad, why doesn't s/he come early?

Say this (Dagaare): A bie baaloŋ vɛŋɛɛ la ka o tuuli e tẽe lɛɛ deɛ te fa o zaa.
Meaning (English): The child's sickness has caused her to search so much for a cure that she has nothing left.

Say this (Dagaare): N dɔɔ, fo baŋ ka ka maaŋ yɔɔ libie zaa poɔ a anaŋ ka fo fa ma la eŋ?
Meaning (English): My friend, do you know that if I paid anything more, you would have robbed me?

Say this (Dagaare): A seŋ ka ba pɔge a nannyige eŋ deŋɛ lɛ, N ba nyɛ teŋɛ na deme o naŋ ba fa.
Meaning (English): It will be good if this thief is imprisoned for life, because there is no town he has not robbed.

Say this (Dagaare): Saa naŋ piili miibu ŋaa, beri ayi ŋa zaa ka te teŋɛ sori yãa na waa faa lɛ.
Meaning (English): With the setting in of the rains, the road leading to our village will soon be very bad.

Say this (Dagaare): A pɔge veɛlɛ la kyɛ o serɛ faa.
Meaning (English): The woman is beautiful but her husband is ugly.

Say this (Dagaare): A bie ŋa yɛlɛ kpeɛŋaa, ka onaŋ sɔre o tɔ bone ka o mɔŋ o maŋ faa la.
Meaning (English): This boy is ruthless, for if he begs from his colleague and is refused to give he takes the thing by force.

Say this (Dagaare): Kɔŋ da kpɛ la a bikpeebɛ ka o kono kyɛ ka pɔge-nimbaaloŋ kaŋ la da faa o ne bondirii.
Meaning (English): The orphan was hungry and began crying, but a benevolent woman came to his aid with food.

Say this (Dagaare): N nyɔge la a kpãao kyɛ ka o faa.
Meaning (English): I caught the guinea fowl but it slipped free and escaped.

Say this (Dagaare): O kyeelɛɛ la gɛrɛ fãa na te le.
O gaa la o sori na fãa.
Meaning (English): S/he has failed to go on her trip.

Say this (Dagaare): A pɔmpeŋ sãaɛ la ka noba fãa kyɛ sigi baa te ɔŋ kõɔ.
Meaning (English): The water tap is spoilt, so people have no choice but to go the stream to fetch water.

Say this (Dagaare): Kɔlaa maŋ nɔŋ ka ba faara o tegitegi lɛ.
Meaning (English): A cat likes to be stroked all the time.

Say this (Dagaare): Naŋkoɔre boma da pale a daa lɛ fage.
Meaning (English): There were many assorted goods in the market.

Say this (Dagaare): A bibiiri zaa zo kulee la fare.
Meaning (English): All the children have gone without any left behind.

Say this (Dagaare): A dɔɔ da ŋmɛ la fasane, a wa te yeli ka o ba la boɔrɔ a o pɔge.
Meaning (English): The man thought for a while and finally said he did not want his wife.

Say this (Dagaare): A nɔnyaŋaa neɛ la nɔbil feelaa kaŋa ko.
Meaning (English): The mother hen has stepped on one of the very young chicks and killed it.

Say this (Dagaare): Feelee kye a die poɔ, fo koŋ nyɛ zie biŋi fo sɛŋɛ.
Meaning (English): There is no space in the room; you can't find space for your bed.

Say this (Dagaare): Bayuo to la o beɛre kyɛ zo gaa e die feerɔɔ, o naŋ kpɛ.
Meaning (English): Bayuo insulted his elder brother and ran into the house at once.

Say this (Dagaare): A da ba seŋ ka o la taa poɔ pampana, a bie na o naŋ taa naŋ ba fẽɛ.
Meaning (English): She should not be pregnant now because the baby she has is still too young.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka fooŋ ba maale fo kyi ŋa biŋi, fo na yeli ka fo erɛ feferɛ ka noore wa la a eŋɛ.
Meaning (English): If you don’t keep your millet well and you make the least move away, fowls will swoop on it.

Say this (Dagaare): A daa kpeɛŋaa, a pɛnnepɛnɛ ba toɔ na fege o zie zaa.
Meaning (English): The wood is so hard that the carver can hardly make any headway to carve out even a small hole.

Say this (Dagaare): A fere ka te sonnɔ nembaalba.
Meaning (English): We are obliged to care for the helpless.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka fooŋ wa deɛnɛ ne a badɔgrɔ bile fo na wa yeli ka fere.
Meaning (English): If you play around that newborn puppy you will come to regret it.

Say this (Dagaare): A e la feroo ka fo eŋe fo bie sakuuri.
Meaning (English): It is compulsory that you send your child to school.

Say this (Dagaare): A baala nyu la a tẽẽ a de goɔoŋ e fɛɛ.
Meaning (English): The patient took his medication and slept soundly.

Say this (Dagaare): Pimbiri kyɔge la a kuriwiri kɔbɔ ka o e fɛɛ, o naŋ yi.
Meaning (English): The tyre of the bicycle was pierced by a nail and deflated at once.

Say this (Dagaare): A dɔɔ kũu maa la maa eŋ noɔre fɛlɛlɛ, ŋmenaa ŋa ka maa ne o puori taa daa poɔ
Meaning (English): The man's death has utterly surprised me, because we greeted each other this afternoon in the marketplace.

Say this (Dagaare): A dɔɔ yeli ka o erɛ fifire ka a kɔlaa de a nɛne.
Meaning (English): No sooner had the man left than the cat snatched the meat.

Say this (Dagaare): N nyɛ la a bie filoo kyɛ ka o kpɛ a lɔɔre.
Meaning (English): I saw the child at a glance before he entered the lorry.

Say this (Dagaare): Fo na gaa la bee fo koŋ gaa?
A bibiiri fogele la taa a lɔɔre poɔ.
Meaning (English): The children are squeezed tightly in the lorry.

Say this (Dagaare): A die waa la fogeloo lɛ.
Dasaŋa na ba maŋ fogiri la nannyige nubi-eɛmɛ.
Meaning (English): In the olden days, thieves had their fingernails pulled out.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka saaŋ ba mi a bɛŋɛ na fogili la.
Meaning (English): If it does not rain the beans will not form seed.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka saaŋ wa mi foŋ bore a kamaana.
Meaning (English): If it rains, you should sow the maize.
They are not looking for you.

Say this (Dagaare): Fo yɔɔpɔge balɛɛ la fooŋ na gaa te ɛre a zɔŋe?
Meaning (English): Your sister is tired, you will have to go and grind the flour.

Say this (Dagaare): O bɛlle ma la ne nufoori.
Meaning (English): S/he deceived me with an empty hand.

Say this (Dagaare): E ka a tuobu fõɔ fẽe ka lɛ naane N koŋ tõɔ a tuo.
Meaning (English): Make the load a little light otherwise I cannot carry it.

Say this (Dagaare): Fo naŋ fori yi, gaa kyɛ wa.
Meaning (English): Since you have already prepared, go and come.

Say this (Dagaare): A pɔgelee ŋa naŋ ba fori kyɛ o pɔloo zuoe la.
Meaning (English): This girl is not yet worth a woman but she is quite proud.

Say this (Dagaare): N woŋee fu kyɛ N ba baŋ ka serɛ la be.
Meaning (English): I have heard a rumour but I am not sure whether it is true.

Say this (Dagaare): O faa le a bogiŋ lɛ fogoŋ.
Meaning (English): S/he fell into the hole at once.

Say this (Dagaare): Naazoɔ deɛ e la n nyɔbogiriŋ lɛ fulo.
Meaning (English): A fly shot into my nose at once.

Say this (Dagaare): A dɔɔ ŋa eŋ daŋ ba iri bonzaa, fuomii yoŋ ka o nɔŋ.
Meaning (English): This man has never contributed anything, he only likes taking things for free.

Say this (Dagaare): A sɔrsɔrɔ tẽɛ la o nu gãa ka nembaaloŋ erɛ a noba ka ba korɔ o libie.
Meaning (English): The beggar stretched out his hand ernestly and the onlookers were moved and began offering him money.

Say this (Dagaare): Neŋkponni mine taa la parre a maŋ de gaane yelmaale daare.
Meaning (English): Some elderly men have triangular underwear which they wear on festive occasions.

Say this (Dagaare): A tendaana ba la nɔgraa gadaa.
Meaning (English): The landlord has ordered the sojourner to leave.

Say this (Dagaare): O daŋe ba gale toma waabo bebiyeni gba.
Meaning (English): S/he never missed going to work even for a day.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka pɔgeŋ wa galle o pɛgebo kaapɔge poɔ la ka o taa.
Meaning (English): If a woman misses her period, then she may be pregnant.

Say this (Dagaare): Te karema maŋ galle la a kɔkɔre ka noɔ kpɛ fo.
Meaning (English): Our teacher manipulates the language such that you enjoy his talk.

Say this (Dagaare): A dɔbɔ ti la taa ganaaganaa, ka ba faara faana.
Meaning (English): The men hooked each other tightly and fiercely such that people were finding it difficult to separate them.

Say this (Dagaare): Bagaŋe zaameŋ doŋe la n baa.
Meaning (English): A mad dog bit my dog yesterday.

Say this (Dagaare): A baa age gaŋ la a bogi.
Meaning (English): The dog jumped over the hole.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba lɔɔre zo wa gaŋ la te deni na bare.
A kparoo waa la kpoŋ gaŋ a bie.
Meaning (English): The shirt is bigger than the child.

Say this (Dagaare): N daga maŋ biŋ la a gaŋene die na poɔ.
Meaning (English): My box is kept in the room after the first one.

Say this (Dagaare): A dɔɔ de la daa gare a sori.
Meaning (English): The man has placed a plank across the road.

Say this (Dagaare): A teɛ le la garepegele a sori.
Meaning (English): The tree fell and crossed/bocked the road.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba geli la a kuri gbori tiili a dankyini poɔ.
Meaning (English): They have lifted over the iron gate unto the wall.

Say this (Dagaare): A boɔ e la zeɛ genegene.
Zie naŋ da wa nyaana genegene la ka o wa.
Meaning (English): S/he came when dawn had not clearly set in.

Say this (Dagaare): A daanedann da maŋe la a naa niŋŋ kyɛ goone iri.
Meaning (English): The praise singer would walk majestically with up-and-down-movement of the body in front of the King.

Say this (Dagaare): Pɔgeba maŋ goɔ la kaabo kyɛ ŋma.
Meaning (English): Women usually hold down guinea corn to cut the head.

Say this (Dagaare): A yɛlɛ ba waa lɛ a pɔge gɔŋ-eŋɛɛ la.
Meaning (English): That is not the true state of the matter; the woman has tried to add something to make it look like that.

Say this (Dagaare): A koɔraa gbaale la o weɛ kɛkɛrɛɛ baare.
Meaning (English): The farmer has finished gathering the stalks on his farm.

Say this (Dagaare): Polsiri nyɔge la a nannyige ka bibiiri gbaale tu.
Meaning (English): The police arrested the thief and children crowded behind them.

Say this (Dagaare): A peroo yie la a de o niŋe gbage sapare kyɛ deɛ zoro.
Meaning (English): When the sheep left the pen it just went running toward the east.
The bride has shaved gbala on her head.

Say this (Dagaare): A bie konni ba e gbale.
Meaning (English): It is not for nothing that the child is crying.
Mary does not have any beads around her waist.

Say this (Dagaare): A sɔ-gbale na koŋ tõɔ ŋmaa a nɛne.
Meaning (English): That blunt knife can't cut the meat.
He has shot an arrow into the sky.

Say this (Dagaare): Lɔɔre ŋmɛ la naabo ka o le a sori zu deɛ gbara.
Meaning (English): The lorry hit the cow and it fell on the road struggling.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba naneŋ nyɔge la a naaweɛmɛ na, a nyɔge gbare.
Meaning (English): When they eventually caught that wild cow, they tied it down by the legs.

Say this (Dagaare): A daa bogi ba sigi yaga lɛnso ka o gbɛgrɛ.
Meaning (English): The hole for the pole is not deep enough; that is why it is shaky.

Say this (Dagaare): N ba taa gbiele derɛ biiri.
Meaning (English): My arms are too week to curdle children.

Say this (Dagaare): Bibiiri deɛnɛ la a peɛ lɛnso ka o gbine.
Meaning (English): Children are playing on the roof; that is why the roof is shaking.

Say this (Dagaare): A dɔɔta kyɔge o la pimbiri ka o deɛ gbiŋi.
Meaning (English): The doctor gave him an injection and he was put out.

Say this (Dagaare): A naŋkpaana gbole kaa la a nuulee naŋ dɔɔ a teɛ zu.
Meaning (English): The hunter looked up to see the bird in the tree.

Say this (Dagaare): Vũũ nyege la a bie ka o gbori na tage yi a daa a doge lɔɔ.
Meaning (English): The fire burnt the child and as he struggled to move away he pushed the pot over.

Say this (Dagaare): O zeŋ gbɔge la a baala.
Meaning (English): He is seated close to the patient.

Say this (Dagaare): A pɔge mɔŋe la a fanfane baare a nyɔge gbulli gbulli sidi sidi.
Meaning (English): When the woman finished making the soap she made it into balls of one cedi each.

Say this (Dagaare): A noɔ gyeɛnɛ la a kyi.
Meaning (English): The fowl is lurking around the millet.

Say this (Dagaare): A bibiiri le gyerre la taa.
Meaning (English): The children fell crisscrossing each other.

Say this (Dagaare): A teere le gyerre la taa.
Meaning (English): The trees fell across one another.

Say this (Dagaare): A porisi bare la gyɛle ka a nannyige zo.
Meaning (English): The police did not pay attention, so the thief escaped.

Say this (Dagaare): A kɔlaa e la gyɛmɛgyɛmɛlɛ kyɛ ɔɔ a nɛne zaa.
Meaning (English): The cat ate all the meat without anyone noticing it.

Say this (Dagaare): Gyɛnne, ɔŋe kõɔ ko ma ka N nyu.
Meaning (English): Please, give me some water to drink.
The hunter has gone into the deep bush.

Say this (Dagaare): Teere are gyili la a bulee.
Meaning (English): The well is surrounded by trees.

Say this (Dagaare): A zie gyiri ka donɛɛ kpeɛbo e kpeɛŋaa.
Meaning (English): Society has declined and life has become difficult.

Say this (Dagaare): Haali ka a bieŋ wa kyɛ te koŋ o a gane.
Meaning (English): Even if the child comes we will not give him/her the book.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka fo toboŋ beɛrɛ ka fo ba kaa a zu velaa fo na woŋi la.
Meaning (English): If you have a disease of the ears and you do not take good care of them, you will be deaf.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba ŋmɛ la baa ka a woŋi ka o nyɛ, bini.
Meaning (English): When they hit the dog it felt so much pain that it defecated.

Say this (Dagaare): Zenɛ, Ayuo zeɛre ŋa nyɛnnoo ba woiŋ.
Meaning (English): Today, there was not the right amount of salt in Ayuo's soup.

Say this (Dagaare): A seŋkãã paale la a pelee zuo, yɛ woɔ ka a ta yaara.
Meaning (English): The basket is too full; remove some of the groundnuts so it does not spill.

Say this (Dagaare): Dabuo da ba poɔrɔ kyɛ beri ayi ŋa o woɔ la o zaa.
Meaning (English): Dabuo used to be plump, but recently he has gotten smaller.

Say this (Dagaare): Yuoni ŋa saa miire la wuu lɛ.
Meaning (English): This year it has been raining unceasingly.

Say this (Dagaare): Zenɛ, koe deɛ waa la wuu lɛ.
Yaa, vɛŋe ka o meŋ tu o deme.
Meaning (English): Oh, do allow him to tell his part of the story, too.

Say this (Dagaare): Dagaaba ba deɛnɛ ne ba yaane puoruu.
Meaning (English): The Dagaaba do not joke with their greetings.

Say this (Dagaare): Yɛ taa la yaane puoruu ne yɛ tonsonne yɛ naŋ toŋe.
Meaning (English): You deserve our gratitude for your good work.

Say this (Dagaare): N koŋ la tõɔ̃ gaa yaane kpɛ ma la.
Meaning (English): I can't go again; I'm tired.

Say this (Dagaare): A boɔraa la puri lɛnso ka a a kyi yaare a sori zu zaa.
Meaning (English): The bag is burst and that is why the millet is scattered all over the road.

Say this (Dagaare): A pelee ŋa noɔre yaare gaŋ la n boɔbo.
Meaning (English): The mouth of this basket is too large for my liking.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka banaŋ ba yaare kodɔɔ bee kopɔge o ba taa sori na toŋ sɛŋgaŋ toma.
Meaning (English): Until the final widowhood rites are performed neither the widow nor the widower can engage in sex.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba yaare la n noɔre ne ba pɔge na yɛlɛ ka N te bale.
Meaning (English): They pestered me about their woman's case until I became fed up.

Say this (Dagaare): A pɔgebeɛlebɛ kyɛ la yieluŋ yabapa pa pa tu a sori gɛrɛ ne a pɔge.
Meaning (English): The bridemaids sang earnestly along the road as they took the bride along.

Say this (Dagaare): Uoni saŋa Dagaaba maŋ yage la baa, a na nyɛ kõɔ̃.
Meaning (English): During the dry season, the Dagaaba dredge wells in order to get water.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka onaŋ ba gaa asibiti o fele na na yage la.
Meaning (English): If she does not go to the hospital, her sore will develop into an ulcer.

Say this (Dagaare): N ba boɔrɔ ka N yage a woɔ poɔ boma, a taa la dabẽɛ.
Meaning (English): I don't want to empty the contents of the bag because they are frightening.

Say this (Dagaare): A bie nyɛ la a saana a deɛ yage nimie eŋ.
Meaning (English): When the child saw the stranger, he gave him a fixed look.

Say this (Dagaare): O pɔge naŋ kpi zaa, o deɛ tori la yeeroo yeerɛ.
Meaning (English): Since his wife's death he has been suffering emotional distress.

Say this (Dagaare): A dɔbɔ ŋmɛ la a kyi ka a pɔgeba te yeɛle.
Meaning (English): The men threshed the millet and the women winnowed it.

Say this (Dagaare): A saa ba mi soŋe, yeɛloo ka o yeɛle.
Meaning (English): It did not really rain; it just drizzled.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba nyɔge la nannyige ka noba deɛ yeɛle tu.
Meaning (English): A thief was arrested and many people ran after the team.

Say this (Dagaare): A yelbalee ŋa eŋɛ la ka o ne o pɔge dare zɔɔ taa.

Say this (Dagaare): Ta bɔ yeli ko o, vɛŋe o ka o gɛrɛ.

Say this (Dagaare): Yeli ne o yelmeŋɛ N zãa ba gaa be.
Meaning (English): As a matter of fact I did not go there.

Say this (Dagaare): Fo na baŋ de la eronwuluu yelbiri maale ne yɛlɛ?
Meaning (English): Can you construct a sentence with an adverb?

Say this (Dagaare): N teɛre ka o yeli la a yɛlɛ ko o ma.
Meaning (English): I guess she has has informed her mother about it.

Say this (Dagaare): O daare yeli la o pɔgeyaa lɛɛ ka o te kono.
Meaning (English): He rebuked his daughter until she wept.

Say this (Dagaare): Lɛ a pɔge naŋ e saŋe a baaloŋ e la yel-lige.
Meaning (English): The way the woman was able to cure the patient is a mystery.

Say this (Dagaare): A dɔɔ na maŋ tona la yel-lige toma.
Ka a tontonmaŋ wa yɛ ba iri.
Meaning (English): When the workers are tired they can stop.

Say this (Dagaare): Maa eŋ yɛɛ la ne a zeɛre ŋa.
Meaning (English): I am tired of this sauce.

Say this (Dagaare): A dɔɔ na bat aa nimizeɛ yel-yɛɛ yoŋ ka o maŋ yele.
Meaning (English): That man is not serious he is always talking of unimportant matters.

Say this (Dagaare): Seŋkãã yɛɛ pɔge la a gbannaa zaa ka fo na teɛre ka ba kɔɛ la.

Say this (Dagaare): Yɛŋ de a bie gaa ne sakuuri.
Meaning (English): Try and take the child to school.

Say this (Dagaare): A pɔgelee na taa la yɛŋe.
A bie yɛŋ ba seŋ bone.
Meaning (English): The child has very little knowledge.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba zaa yɛre la tigiri bonsuuri.
Meaning (English): They all dressed their best for the feast.

Say this (Dagaare): Ka fooŋ na yɛre ferebo la ka fo taa libima.
Meaning (English): If you want to engage in business, you must have some capital.

Say this (Dagaare): A bibiiri gaa pɛ la seŋkãa yɛɛ.
Meaning (English): The children went harvesting wild groundnuts.

Say this (Dagaare): Te naŋ yi ka te gaa a kpaaroŋ la ka saa deɛ wa miire.
Meaning (English): As we went out to go to the farm, it started raining.

Say this (Dagaare): A dɔɔ nɔŋ la o pɔge ŋmeɛbo lɛnso ka o yi.
Meaning (English): The man likes beating his wife and that is why she has divorced him.

Say this (Dagaare): Fo ba pɛge a laa ne fanfane a zuiŋ o ba yi.
Meaning (English): You did not wash the bowl with soap and so it is not clean.

Say this (Dagaare): A bie ŋa yi la o ma yaga.
Meaning (English): This child resembles the mother very much.

Meaning (English): Because the beer was not covered, it has lost its taste.

Meaning (English): When a cobra is frightened, it spreads out its head and neck.

Say this (Dagaare): A bie dɔŋɛɛ la ka o zu deɛ waa yigileŋ lɛ.
Meaning (English): The child has grown so lean that his head is literally perching on his neck.

Say this (Dagaare): N yeli la a kpaaroŋ yɛlɛ ko fo ta erɛ wa yinni.
Meaning (English): I told you about the meeting, so don't forget.

Say this (Dagaare): Sẽɛ̃ yɔgelɔ la ka suŋkpulo kyoɔrɔ.
Meaning (English): The farming season is coming round; hence, dawdaw trees are flowering.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba leŋ la a tuobu kyɛ ka a leɛ yɔgere.

Say this (Dagaare): Zenɛ kpare yuo la ka a baala su.
Meaning (English): Today the patient is wearing a different shirt.

Say this (Dagaare): A kõɔ zaa ka ba nyu.
Meaning (English): They have drank all the water.

Meaning (English): I thought she was in the room, but to my surprise it was only the child that was there.

Say this (Dagaare): Zagela maŋ yeli ka o puoro la kyɛ zeɛre o taaba.
Meaning (English): Some people claim to be godly but hate their neigbours.

Say this (Dagaare): A yɛlɛ pãã ta la a zanzaŋ.
Meaning (English): The matter has now got to the climax.

Say this (Dagaare): Yelzeɛ la ka ba yele, azuiŋ ta laara.
Meaning (English): It is a serious case, so don't laugh.

Say this (Dagaare): A pɔgeba zaa ne ba biiri da la, zɛgelɛkɛlɛ.
Meaning (English): Each of the women had a child.

Say this (Dagaare): A bie kono tuuro la o ma kyɛ ka o deɛ ba taa zigoo zaa.
Meaning (English): The child is crying while running after the mother but woman did not show any concern.

Say this (Dagaare): A soɔ lɔre la kõɔ poɔ ana la so ka o le zõɔ.
Meaning (English): The knife got soaked in water and that is why it is rusted.

Say this (Dagaare): A gane dɔgele la a tabol zu.
Meaning (English): The book is on the table.

Say this (Dagaare): Ba ŋmɛ la a bɔle baare ka a noba ta zugi zugi zugi ba naŋ yire.
Meaning (English): The football match is over and the spectators are trouping out.

Say this (Dagaare): A bie baaloŋ zuiŋ o ma ba gaa toma.
Meaning (English): As a result of the child's illness, the mother didn't go to work.

Say this (Dagaare): A saama na waa la yaga a zuiŋ maale a bondirii yaga.
Meaning (English): There will be many guests, so cook plenty of food.

Say this (Dagaare): Deyɛŋ boŋkoɔre ba maale ka nembaaleba da nyu ba zuŋmane kõɔ.
Meaning (English): Last year, there was a poor crop yield and poor people suffered greatly.
